candidate_observations.address: Card Factory, 32 Victoria Street, Paignton, Devon, TQ4 5DN
observed_facts: Sportswift Limited, company 03493972, is active and pays £22,000 under a five-year lease from 8 October 2022.
The lease ends on 7 October 2027 and the property is a 999-year virtual freehold at peppercorn rent.
A 2016 combined 30/32 Victoria Street record carried £42,000 for Card Factory plus residential income, but the 2026 lot is the separate 32 Victoria Street commercial interest.
The final 2026 status is Withdrawn Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The 2016 combined income was not carried into the separate 2026 lot; residential upper floors available by separate negotiation were not counted and rent was not extended beyond October 2027.

observed_facts: Phoenix Vapers Limited, company 11133744, is active and pays £20,000 under a five-year lease from 24 April 2024.
The lease has no breaks, expires in April 2029 and is outside the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 security-of-tenure provisions.
The landlord holds a £6,000 rent deposit.
The final status is Sold Post and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The deposit was not counted as annual income, no sale price was inferred and the active company status was not treated as proof of rent payment.

candidate_observations.address: Mountain Warehouse, 30 Victoria Street, Paignton, Devon, TQ4 5DN
observed_facts: Mountain Warehouse Limited, company 03417738, is active and pays £28,500 under a five-year lease from 14 March 2023.
The renewed lease ends in March 2028 and the interest is a 999-year virtual freehold at peppercorn rent.
A 2016 combined 30/32 Victoria Street record carried a £35,000 Mountain Warehouse rent, but the 2026 separate lot records the rebased £28,500 rent.
The final status is Withdrawn Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The old £35,000 rent was not retained, no break position was invented where the 2026 page did not state one, and separately negotiable residential upper floors were not counted.

candidate_observations.address: Dulux Decorator Centre, Unit 60-72 New Town Row, Birmingham, B6 4HP
observed_facts: S K Properties & Developments Ltd, company 14032990, is active and holds the majority under a 125-year lease ending 1 January 2138 with no breaks.
The £36,570 owner income is ground rent and the occupational property is underlet to Dulux Decorator Centre.
The rent rises to £44,579 on 4 January 2033 under the stated fixed review structure.
The first and second floor office interest is let to an individual at peppercorn rent.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £36,570 was not described as Dulux occupational rent, peppercorn income was not counted and no rent beyond the published 2033 reversion was forecast.

candidate_observations.address: B&M, 66-68 High Street, Weston-Super-Mare, Somerset, BS23 1HS
observed_facts: B & M Retail Limited, company 01357507, is active and pays £120,000 under a three-year lease from February 2025.
The current lease ends in February 2028 and covers approximately 19,471 sq ft.
A 2022 marketing record showed an ABF Investments lease at £294,000 expiring in February 2025; that historic income is no longer current.
The 2026 property remains Available and no guide price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The expired £294,000 rent was not retained, no post-February-2028 income was projected and general company charges were not treated as property default.

candidate_observations.address: 130-136 Poole Road, Westbourne, Bournemouth, Dorset, BH4 9EF
observed_facts: Aspect International Language Academies Limited, company 02162156, is active and pays £272,928 under a lease expiring in March 2030 with Kaplan Inc guarantee.
Published fixed rents are £279,750 in 2027, £286,745 in 2028 and £293,914 in 2029.
The tenant has an option to renew in 2030 for fifteen years at a minimum £301,261 with 2.5% fixed annual increases.
The property is Withdrawn Post and change-of-use potential remains subject to the lease and necessary consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Future stepped rents were kept separate from current income, the 2030 option was not treated as exercised and no sale price or planning permission was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Holiday Inn Express, Reedfield Place, Walton Summit Centre, Bamber Bridge, Preston, PR5 8AA
observed_facts: Yeoman Preston Property Ltd, company 10800518, is active and holds a long lease to 3017 with no breaks.
The owner income is £69,687 ground rent with annual upward-only RPI reviews subject to a 0% collar and 5% cap.
The property comprises a 103-bedroom hotel and part of the car park is underlet to Tesla Motors Limited for EV charging.
Companies House records two outstanding charges whose descriptions expressly identify the Holiday Inn Express property.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The ground rent was not represented as hotel operating income, future RPI rent was not calculated and property-specific charges were not treated as proof of payment default.

observed_facts: Lakeland Limited, company 00809688, is active.
The advertised £70,000 lease is for fifteen years but is stated to commence on completion of the sale.
The tenant has an option to determine on the tenth anniversary of the term.
The remaining upper-floor residential accommodation is let on a separate long lease.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £70,000 was not treated as an already commenced lease while the property remained Available, the break option was retained and no residential income was inferred.
